name: The Big Payback

faq.answer: Ruzzgot is a caravaneer working out of Booty Bay whose business depends on reliably delivering goods across the region.
A nearby Venture Co. agent stole Ruzzgot's valuables, as recorded in a recovered delivery ledger noting the heist.

aliases: why does ruzzgot care about his shipment
what happens if ruzzgot loses his delivery
faq.answer: A caravaneer lives and dies by trust and reliability, and losing his cargo threatens his standing in Booty Bay.
faq.q: Why does recovering the shipment matter to Ruzzgot?

faq.answer: Ruzzgot offers to help arrange shipping for the recovered valuables onward to Powderfuse Port.
faq.q: Where was the shipment destined to go?

sections.body: A recovered ledger details each run made by the caravaneer Ruzzgot, ending on a bitter record of theft. A nearby Venture Co. agent seized his shipment, and the stolen valuables remain in the operative's hands. Ruzzgot waits in Booty Bay for someone to settle the score and return what was taken before his livelihood is ruined.
sections.title: A Stolen Shipment

sections.body: Reclaiming the cargo restores Ruzzgot's faith in his standing as a trader. With his goods back in hand, he turns right back to business, offering to help arrange transit onward to Powderfuse Port.
sections.title: Back in Business

summary: A stolen ledger reveals that a Venture Co. agent took the caravaneer Ruzzgot's valuables. The goods remain in the thief's hands, and Ruzzgot needs his cargo returned to protect his trade in Booty Bay.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Big Payback
